name: EPIC 212062256
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 10.6 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,697 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 0.91 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,630 K at its surface.
